name: Nob

related_people.name: Abiathar
related_people.role: the sole priest of this town to escape Saul's massacre, fleeing to David

related_people.name: Ahimelech
related_people.role: the priest here who fed the fugitive David and gave him Goliath's sword

related_people.name: Doeg
related_people.role: reported the priests of this town to Saul, then carried out their massacre

description: A priestly town where the fugitive David received bread and Goliath's sword from the priest Ahimelech (1 Samuel 21:1-9), an act of unwitting help that led Saul, informed by Doeg the Edomite, to order the massacre of Nob's priests and townspeople (1 Samuel 22:9-19).
family_friendly_summary: Nob was a town of priests where David, running from Saul, was given bread and Goliath's sword by the priest Ahimelech. When Saul found out, he was so angry that he had the priests of Nob killed for helping David. Only one priest, Abiathar, escaped and fled to David.
